## Health Score Rubric

Compute each category score (0-100), then combine them into one overall score.

### Counting
- Deduplicate the same root cause across pages. Use one primary category, first applicable: Links (navigation), Accessibility (access barriers), Functional (behavior), Performance (speed), Visual (layout), Content (copy), UX (friction), Console (remaining errors). No double deductions.

### Console
Deduplicate reproducible errors/exceptions by message+source across pages.
- 0 errors → 100
- 1-3 errors → 70
- 4-10 errors → 40
- 11+ errors → 10

### Links
- 0 broken → 100
- Each broken link → -15 (minimum 0)

### Per-Category Scoring (Visual, Functional, UX, Content, Performance, Accessibility)
Start at 100; deduct per finding:
- Critical issue → -25
- High issue → -15
- Medium issue → -8
- Low issue → -3
Floor: 0.

### Final Score
Combine the category scores into an overall score out of 100. Categories that matter more to users (core functionality, accessibility) should count for more than cosmetic ones, so weight them accordingly. Use your judgment about how much each category should contribute for the site under test.
